summary: 26 features and 7 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hagitask-vaults: support editable reference vaults (0acd29b)
  • project-vaults: add project-scoped vault lookup (36e08f7)
  • windows-runtime: opt out of process speed throttling (14f2fe7)
  • startup: brand the console banner with HagiCode (a54b4d5)
  • project-prompt-library: add project prompt management (10a69fc)
  • monospec-achievements: track project detection and archive commits (92a5be5)
  • proposal-planning: add an Impeccable polish direction (a307ca0)
  • repository-scope: resolve select-all repositories at runtime (bf0afce)
  • openspec-apply: define consistent lifecycle output blocks (8dce978)
  • daily-cycles: use server-local days for daily events (107e9d1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • vault: allow editing selected research vaults (0b9ec52)
  • wizard: add demo projects and model defaults (a834b09)
  • onboarding: guide users through first conversations (a4ecbd8)
  • vault: add project-scoped vault selection support (72d97ad)
  • images: import scenario and planning art from R2 (79b011b)
  • prompt-library: move prompt management into project details (d832075)
  • prompt-library: add project prompt library management (8860e17)
  • hero: show registered scenario stage backgrounds (3e1a0c2)
  • session: show generated planning direction icons (8f69c7b)
  • images: support planning and scenario asset pipelines (81be318)
  • scheduled-plan: show calendar details in a side drawer (c10bd92)
  • proposal: add Impeccable polish planning direction (6ce4b30)
  • repository-selection: add select-all request scopes (01166dd)
  • preset-task: improve file tabs and phone drawer layout (c7bdeee)
  • conversation: add structured lifecycle result cards (60217fa)
  • startup-splash: expand the gallery to six hundred images (abbb534)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • agent-cli-monitoring: reuse resolved CLI paths for versions (4d8c335)
  • session-images: provide a prompt for image-only messages (a278d43)

HagiCode-org/web

  • prompt-library: preserve initial loads under StrictMode (5acb2ae)
  • input: hide remote voice controls on small screens (2347d91)
  • hagitask: simplify the management view on phones (0becc9d)
  • conversation: keep phone headers clear and titles contained (963a518)
  • reports: use server-local dates for daily features (3616a11)
